channel.title: Zorix Release Notes
channel.description: Product updates, model releases, research, and platform changes from Zorix.

item.title: Introducing Zorix Nex Coder 3.8
item.description: Nex Coder 3.8 enters Early Access Preview with Mercury, Uranus, and Neptune on the AA4 — Zorix4 architecture.

item.title: AA4 — Zorix4 architecture
item.description: Zorix introduces the system architecture behind Nex Coder 3.8.

item.title: Zorix NexHate for context-aware translation
item.description: NexHate is announced as an advanced translation model focused on meaning, tone, and context.

item.title: Introducing Zorix Star Light
item.description: Zorix announces its first video-generation model.

item.title: VIREXA 3 is released
item.description: VIREXA 3 launches with improvements to image quality, coherence, and prompt understanding.

item.title: Nex Coder 3.6 Pro Preview
item.description: Nex Coder 3.6 Pro Preview becomes the primary model, focused on longer software-engineering workflows.

item.title: Nex Coder 3.5 Pro
item.description: A coding-first model for larger repositories, debugging, tool use, and multi-file changes.

item.title: A new Zorix experience and Zorix Code
item.description: Deep, Balanced, and Fast processing modes arrive alongside Zorix Code Early Access.

item.title: Introducing Zorix Metron
item.description: Zorix launches a platform for comparing AI models and understanding their strengths across tasks.

item.title: Zorix 1.5 Coder
item.description: An early coding model marks Zorix's move into AI and software systems.
